note: Brown County IL publishes no queryable zoning district layer. Its ArcGIS Online parcel viewer (services1.arcgis.com/aHxsJXn8GAlRIIIg) has Parcels, Cities, Townships, Roads, etc., but no zoning layer, and the Parcels layer has no zoning field. The county's and Mount Sterling's zoning maps are only PDFs (Mt. Sterling Zoning Map PDF, Updated City Limits Zoning Map PDF). No county zoning service was found in searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online or county sites.
